_doc: Pi-IR projection of web_search_server_tool/messages_sse.json. Pi's state machine has NO branch for server_tool_use or web_search_tool_result content blocks (see refs/anthropic/claude-agent-sdk-recon-2026-06-23/upstream/claude-agent-sdk-pi/index.ts content_block.type switch — only text/thinking/tool_use exist). Pi simply does not surface server-side tool events to its output.content[]. XLI does — it projects server_tool_use(web_search) + web_search_tool_result into ResponseItem::WebSearchCall. This fixture documents the ASYMMETRY (XLI extension beyond pi vocabulary) and is the canonical anchor for RI-022 cross-wire coverage.
